# SBREBROWN

> A comprehensive fountain pen resource featuring video reviews, ink databases, pen tuning guides, and expert analysis by Stephen B.R.E. Brown.

SBREBROWN is a content creator and pen enthusiast with academic credentials in psychology who produces in-depth fountain pen reviews, educational video series, and maintains searchable databases for inks and pen specifications. The site aggregates video content from YouTube alongside written guides, tutorials, and personal collection showcases.

## Key Topics

- fountain pens
- pen reviews
- pen maintenance
- ink reviews
- nib types
- video series
- pen tuning
- Montblanc
- Akkerman
- inkcyclopedia
- pen collecting
- writing instruments
- paper reviews
- YouTube content
- pen comparison

## Fountain Pen Reviews & Databases

- [Fountain Pen Reviews](https://www.sbrebrown.com/the-youtube-fountain-pen-reviews): Searchable database and index of YouTube fountain pen video reviews
- [Inkcyclopedia](https://www.sbrebrown.com/inkcyclopedia): Comprehensive ink database with color comparisons from major manufacturers
- [Serious Nibbage](https://www.sbrebrown.com/serious-nibbage): Video series reviewing high-quality fountain pen nibs and writing quality
- [How Do You Like Me Now](https://www.sbrebrown.com/how-do-you-like-me-now): Long-term follow-up reviews revisiting luxury fountain pens with updated opinions
- [Personal Pens of SBREBROWN](https://www.sbrebrown.com/personal-pens-of-sbrebrown): Video series showcasing personal luxury fountain pen collection and profiles

## Pen Maintenance & Tuning Guides

- [Pen Tuning](https://www.sbrebrown.com/fountain-pen-tuning): Tutorial collection for DIY fountain pen maintenance, repair, and restoration
- [Disassembly Line](https://www.sbrebrown.com/disassembly-line): Video series with mechanical breakdown and how-to guides for fountain pens
- [General Pen-Related Videos](https://www.sbrebrown.com/general-pen-videos): Guides covering nib types, maintenance, filling mechanisms, and beginner advice
- [Consult the Doctor](https://www.sbrebrown.com/consult-the-doctor): Q&A video series answering fountain pen maintenance and collecting questions

## Inks & Paper Resources

- [Inks](https://www.sbrebrown.com/inks): Fountain pen ink reviews, color recommendations, and mixing information
- [Paper](https://www.sbrebrown.com/paper): Notebook and paper product reviews with quality comparisons for fountain pens

## Creative Content & Collaborations

- [Drawing with the Professor](https://www.sbrebrown.com/drawing-with-the-professor): Drawing instruction video series with Professor Tarquin Danglebury using fountain pens
- [The Pen O'Clock News](https://www.sbrebrown.com/fountain-pen-related/the-pen-oclock-news): Collaborative news video series with GourmetPens covering fountain pen industry updates

## About & Resources

- [About Me](https://www.sbrebrown.com/about-me): Personal biography of Stephen B.R.E. Brown, content creator and pen enthusiast
- [Academia](https://www.sbrebrown.com/academia): Academic background, credentials, and psychology research from University of Amsterdam
- [Pens, Paper, Ink](https://www.sbrebrown.com/fountain-pen-related): Hub for fountain pen reviews, tuning, and ink content across multiple platforms
- [Discount Codes](https://www.sbrebrown.com/discount-codes): Promotional coupon codes for sponsor partners including Montblanc and P.W. Akkerman
